_meta.data_freshness: Program existence, type, chain/ecosystem, region, and dilution posture are evergreen and verified through June 2026. TIME-SENSITIVE fields (application deadlines, open/closed cohort status, current prize pool / check size, cadence) are baseline snapshots and MUST be re-verified live before the user applies or acts.
_meta.coverage: Global. Every entry is region-tagged. Southeast Asia / Vietnam-relevant entries carry sea_relevant: true.

opportunities.name: a16z Crypto Startup Accelerator (CSX)
opportunities.notes: Intensive multi-week program from a16z crypto. Network-heavy, founder-friendly. Check the official page for the next cohort window.

opportunities.name: Alliance DAO
opportunities.notes: Applications for cohort ALL19 (starting Jan 11, 2027) have a deadline of September 23, 2026. Rolling review.

opportunities.name: Outlier Ventures Base Camp
opportunities.notes: Accepting early applications for the 2026 cohort. Often called the "YC of Web3"; 300+ startups accelerated. "Post-Web" thesis (internet for humans and machines). Token-launch and go-to-market focus.

opportunities.name: TachyonX (formerly Tachyon Accelerator)
opportunities.notes: Successor to the Tachyon accelerator, run by Consensys Mesh with a focus on AI and Crypto. Operates on a rolling admission basis, but review of new applications is paused until Fall 2026.

opportunities.name: YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs)
opportunities.notes: EASY Residency Season 5 applications are open with a deadline of September 13, 2026. The main URL has been unreliable; application information is confirmed via other channels.

opportunities.name: Base ecosystem grants (Coinbase / Base)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: 1-5 ETH for builder grants, 2 ETH weekly for weekly rewards
opportunities.notes: Funding is primarily through the Base Ecosystem Fund and a programmatic reward system via the Base Dashboard and Builder Codes.

opportunities.name: Colosseum Eternal (Solana accelerator)
opportunities.notes: The 'Eternal' track is open for rolling applications until ~Sep 6, 2026. Next main hackathon is Fall 2026, but specific dates are not yet announced.

opportunities.name: Draper University Web3 / Crypto programs
opportunities.notes: Applications for the general Hero Training Fall 2026 session (Oct 11 - Nov 15) are open.

opportunities.name: Antler (Web3 track)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Pre-seed check (typically equity) after the residency
opportunities.notes: No dedicated 'Web3 track', but Web3 is a core part of its general residencies. London applications are open for Sep 22 cohort. Singapore intake is Oct 5.

opportunities.name: Founders, Inc. (f.inc)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Space, resources, and investment for some teams
opportunities.notes: The Campus program is open for rolling applications for a two-week campus residency.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Foundation Ecosystem Support Program (ESP)
opportunities.notes: The EF is undergoing a reorganization, but the ESP continues to fund core protocol security and public goods. The Q2 2026 report detailed over $5.5M in funding.

opportunities.name: Arbitrum Foundation Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: ARB grants, milestone-based; tiered amounts (incl. focused funds like Trailblazer)
opportunities.notes: Multiple programs are active, including the Arbitrum Audit Program, ArbiFuel, Arbitrum Gaming Ventures, and the Alchemy-Arbitrum Grant Program. Older programs like Trailblazer 2.0 are inactive.

opportunities.name: Optimism Grants (proactive)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: OP token grants via Collective grant programs
opportunities.notes: The grants process is being restructured, with a new Strategic Ecosystem Fund. Retro Funding is paused until at least 2027.

opportunities.name: Web3 Foundation Grants (Polkadot / Kusama)
opportunities.notes: The general grants program is discontinued. Funding is now channeled through Strategic Funding, the Polkadot Treasury, and other ecosystem-led initiatives like the Fast-Grants Programme.

opportunities.name: Interchain Foundation Grants (Cosmos)
opportunities.notes: The ICF continues to fund core infrastructure via Cosmos Labs. Specific grant rounds (e.g., AI-focused) are periodic; check the website for current RFPs.

opportunities.name: NEAR Foundation Grants / Ecosystem funding
opportunities.notes: Funding is now primarily through Protocol Rewards (performance-based) and the NEAR Horizon accelerator.

opportunities.name: Sui Foundation Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Milestone-based grants for Sui ecosystem projects
opportunities.notes: The Foundation has shifted from general grants to the Hydropower accelerator, direct investment, and targeted RFPs.

opportunities.name: Filecoin / Protocol Labs Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Open grants up to $50k and RFPs; milestone-based
opportunities.notes: Foundation Open Grants are active and accepting applications. Requests for Proposals (RFPs) are currently inactive.

opportunities.name: ETHGlobal (hackathon series)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Per-event prize pools (commonly $200K+) across sponsor tracks
opportunities.cadence: multiple in-person + online events per year
opportunities.notes: Upcoming events: ETHOnline (Sep 4-16), ETHGlobal Tokyo (Sep 25-27), ETHGlobal Mumbai (Nov 6-8).

opportunities.name: Colosseum Solana Hackathons (Frontier, etc.)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Large prize pools + $250k investment into top teams via Eternal
opportunities.notes: The 'Eternal Challenge' is open for applications. The next major hackathon is 'Frontier', with dates to be announced.

opportunities.name: DoraHacks (global hackathon + BUIDL platform)
opportunities.notes: Platform is continuously active with numerous hackathons for partners like Solana, Aptos, and BNBChain. Features the BUIDL AI tool for hackathon organization.

opportunities.name: Polkadot ecosystem hackathons
opportunities.notes: 2026 schedule includes the Polkadot Solidity Hackathon (Q1), Blockspace Synergy Hackathon (Q2), and MERGE Madrid (Q4). The old build.polkadot.network URL is dead.

opportunities.name: Gitcoin Grants & Bounties
opportunities.notes: The platform has transitioned to 'Gitcoin 3.0', a continuous funding model. The next major round is Gitcoin Grants 25 (GG25).

opportunities.name: Immunefi (security bug bounties)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Bug-bounty payouts (up to millions for critical findings)
opportunities.notes: Platform is active with major bounties from LayerZero, ether.fi, and others. Over $190B in assets protected.

opportunities.name: Optimism Retro Funding (RetroPGF)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: OP rewards distributed for proven ecosystem impact
opportunities.notes: The Retro Funding program is paused until 2027. The platform now showcases results from previous rounds.

opportunities.name: Drips (continuous retroactive dependency funding)
opportunities.notes: Stellar Wave 7 is the latest version; no announcement on Wave 8 yet.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Protocol Fellowship (EPF)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Stipend + mentorship to contribute to Ethereum core protocol
opportunities.notes: Applications for the 2026 cohort (EPF7) are now open.

opportunities.name: Solana ecosystem developer fellowships / bootcamps
opportunities.notes: Multiple developer bootcamps are active. No specific programs labeled 'Fellowships' are currently listed, but grants are available.

opportunities.name: Sky Mavis / Ronin ecosystem grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Ecosystem grants for games/apps on Ronin
opportunities.notes: The Ronin Forge Innovation Grant is active and accepting applications. The Proof of Distribution model also provides continuous, performance-based rewards.

opportunities.name: Kyros Ventures / Coin98 ecosystem programs
opportunities.notes: GMVN Blockchain Week 2025 has been announced. No specific 'Web3 Matching program' is listed, but incubation and network services are ongoing.

opportunities.name: Hashed Emergent (India / SEA)
opportunities.notes: Applications for Hashed Vibe Haus (Edition 2) are open on an invite-only basis. India Blockchain Week 2026 is in November.

opportunities.name: Tribe Accelerator (Singapore)
opportunities.notes: The MedTech Innovation Programme is inviting applications. Check the website for future general cohort applications.

opportunities.name: sqrDAO builder programs & bounties (Vietnam / SEA)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Community bounties, hackathon support, and builder programs
opportunities.notes: The sqrBUIDL Accelerator is active with Solana and Lisk seasons. A new sqrAgent program has been added. The DAO continues to run builder programs and events.

opportunities.name: Superteam Vietnam (Solana)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Bounties, grants, and hackathon support for Solana builders
opportunities.notes: A new global hackathon on DAOs and Network States is active. Superteam Earn is the primary platform for bounties.

opportunities.name: Corelia Academy (Vietnam Web3 education)
opportunities.notes: UniHackfest 2026 is in the product-building phase, with qualifying rounds in September. The domain is bot-protected and may fail automated checks.

opportunities.name: VBI Academy (Vietnam Blockchain Innovation Academy)
opportunities.notes: The Digital Assets Literacy 2026 program is ongoing. The NextX 2026 startup series is in its final stage, with the grand final on August 29.

opportunities.name: UniHackfest (Vietnam national student hackathon)
opportunities.notes: Registration for the 2026 edition was in June-July. The program is in the building phase, with Demo Day on September 26.

opportunities.name: RMIT Vietnam FinTech Club / Hack-A-Venture
opportunities.notes: No announcement for a 2026 edition yet. The dedicated rmithackaventure.com domain has lapsed.

opportunities.name: HUST BK Fintech Hackday
opportunities.notes: Season 13 (UniHackfest 2026 Hanoi Campus) idea submission deadline is August 23, 2026.

opportunities.name: Vietnam Aptos Hackathon (DoraHacks)
opportunities.notes: This hackathon ran in 2025 and is now closed.

opportunities.name: VietBUIDL Hackathon
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Large global prize pool (~$4M reported, 2025 edition)
opportunities.notes: The last VietBUIDL Hackathon was in 2025. No 2026 edition has been announced.
